## Improvements
- Dictate Live now works with cloud transcription models, not just on-device ones.
- Switching to Dictate Live no longer resets your transcription model back to a local one.

## Installation
Download the DMG from the [releases page](https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/releases), open it, and drag WhisperShortcut to your Applications folder.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/compare/v9.07...v9.08
